_comment: Surfaces to capture on a fresh profile with AI off. Keys: id (unique, kebab-case), how (plain-language steps for a driver), must_not_show (what a failure looks like), launch_flags (optional extra browser flags), capture (screenshot, or devtools+screenshot when a WebUI page's text can be read), url (optional page to open), allowed_phrases (optional text that may appear here). Every how and shortcut is a guess until a binary exists: TODO(binary).

surfaces.how: Open a new tab with Cmd+T and wait for chrome://newtab to settle. Capture the whole page, including the address/search box in the middle.
must_not_show: Ask AI, Chat, or Assistant text
an AI button next to the search box

surfaces.how: On the new tab page, click the search box and type 'how do I tie a knot'. Capture while the text is still in the box and no suggestions have been chosen.
must_not_show: an Ask or Search mode pill appearing as you type

surfaces.how: In a normal window with the sidebar full (the default), capture the whole window with the pointer away from the edges.
must_not_show: a Chat or Assistant button in the top bar
an AI entry anywhere in the sidebar

surfaces.how: Hide the sidebar, then move the pointer to the left edge of the window so the full sidebar slides over the page. Capture once it has finished appearing.
must_not_show: an AI entry in the revealed sidebar

surfaces.how: Move the pointer to the right edge of the window, mid-height, where the assistant pull handle sits with AI on. Hold for one second and capture the right 120 pixels of the window.
must_not_show: a pull handle or tab on the right edge
a hover highlight on the right edge
a side panel opening when the pointer pushes against the edge

surfaces.how: Switch to the horizontal toolbar layout (Settings > Appearance), focus the address bar with Cmd+L, and capture the toolbar and the open dropdown.
must_not_show: an AI or Chat button in the toolbar
an Ask AI row in the dropdown

surfaces.how: With the vertical layout (the default), focus the address bar in the sidebar with Cmd+L, type 'rac browser', and capture the sidebar and the dropdown.
must_not_show: an AI or Chat button beside the address bar
an Ask AI row in the dropdown

surfaces.how: Open the command bar with its keyboard shortcut (TODO(binary): confirm the shortcut; Cmd+T opens it when the command bar replaces the new tab page). Type 'ask' and capture the results.
must_not_show: an Ask AI, Chat, or Summarize action
any AI-related result for the query 'ask'

surfaces.how: On any normal web page, select a sentence and right-click the selection. Capture the open context menu.
Right-click a link on a normal web page. Capture the open context menu.
Right-click a tab in the sidebar. Capture the open context menu.
Open the application menu (the one named after the app, left of File) and capture it.
Open the File menu in the menu bar and capture it (use the menu's own window, not the desktop).
Open the Edit menu in the menu bar and capture it.
Open the View menu in the menu bar and capture it.
Open the History menu in the menu bar and capture it.
Open the Bookmarks menu in the menu bar and capture it.
Open the Tab menu in the menu bar and capture it.
Open the Window menu in the menu bar and capture it.
Open the Help menu in the menu bar and capture it.
On a normal page, press Cmd+F, type the four words 'zzqx vwkj plmn trrb' (no page contains them), and capture the find bar with its 'no matches' state.
Hover a link on a normal page, hold the Option key for one second without clicking, and capture the page.
must_not_show: a summary card or tooltip for the link

surfaces.how: Open chrome://rac-ai in a tab. With AI off it must load the ordinary new tab page instead.

Start rac on a profile that has never run (without --no-first-run) and capture each onboarding screen. It may ask whether to enable AI; the default answer is 'Later'. That question is the one allowed AI mention here.
must_not_show: any AI mention outside the single enable question
a provider or API key field

surfaces.how: Open chrome://settings and capture the main page, scrolled to the top and then to the bottom.
must_not_show: AI words in any row or search hint

surfaces.how: Open chrome://settings/privacy and capture the page.
must_not_show: AI words outside stock Chromium strings

surfaces.how: Open chrome://settings/assistant and capture the page. This is the one place AI words may appear with AI off: it holds the switch that turns AI on.
